problem: Set discrepancy: is sqrt(n) removable after the log is?
surface_leak: A sqrt(n) concentration factor survives in Spencer's 6 sqrt n, in the same shape as the log that came off.
why_negative: The columns of an n x n Hadamard matrix satisfy |<x, a_i>| >= sqrt(n) for EVERY sign vector x, so sqrt(n) is sharp; only the constant is in question. This is the matched negative for case 8: the log is removable, the sqrt(n) is not.

sources.cite: Hadamard-matrix lower bound, standard; recent constant work reaches 8 sqrt n for matrix Spencer
